name: Missouri
overview: Under Missouri law the county collector offers land with delinquent taxes at a public auction each year on the fourth Monday in August, starting at 10 o'clock, at or near the courthouse; the collector may also run it online at the same time. After payment the collector gives the buyer a certificate of purchase rather than a deed. The owner has an absolute right to redeem during the following year by paying the amount due plus interest at the rate in the certificate, not more than ten percent a year, and the right to redeem ends when the buyer gets the deed.

counties.how_to_bid: Bidder registration opens August 1 and closes on the Thursday before the sale. Bidders must be Missouri residents or registered Missouri businesses and must not owe delinquent personal property or real estate taxes. Winning bids are paid by cashier's check before 3:30 PM on the sale day (no cash, cards, ACH or personal or business checks). Owners can redeem for one year after a standard sale and 90 days after a Third Offer sale; Post-Third Offer sales have no redemption period.

counties.office: Office of the Sheriff, City of St. Louis (Land Tax Sales)
counties.address: 10 N. Tucker Blvd, 8th Floor, Civil Courts Building, St. Louis, MO 63101
counties.schedule_rule: The City of St. Louis holds land tax sales several times a year.
counties.next_sale_note: Land tax sales have concluded for the year. The last 2026 sale on the Collector's schedule was Sale 240 (October 6, 2026). 2027 dates not yet posted.
counties.how_to_bid: Pre-register online at least 10 days before the sale (one application per person or business); the Sheriff checks that the bidder has no delinquent city property taxes, unpaid special tax bills or pending building or housing code violations. Approved bidders get an email and pick up a bidder number on the first sale day with a valid State ID. Sales begin at 9:00 am outdoors on the 11th Street side of the Civil Courts Building, and bidding starts at the taxes owed. Pay by cashier's check or money order to 'Sheriff City of St. Louis' by 2:00 PM on the sale day, with a separate $150.00 payment per parcel; cash is no longer accepted.
